name: halliday-sfl-analysis-skill
description: Hallidayan and Chinese SFL analysis with auditable grammatical-metaphor annotation and source-verified citations.

interface.shortDescription: Auditable English/Chinese SFL and GM annotation.
interface.longDescription: Analyze English and Chinese texts through field, tenor, mode, ideational, interpersonal, and textual meaning; identify grammatical metaphor with independent ideational/interpersonal labels, strict MPP agnate selection, schema-valid JSON, counterevidence, and human-review flags; preserve private PDF/PPTX/EPUB evidence with integrity metadata; and support theoretical claims with complete source identities and verified page, slide, or EPUB section citations.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this text with Hallidayan SFL at full depth and cite page-verified primary sources.
Analyze this Chinese clause with the Chinese SFL framework and give a natural Chinese congruent form.
Annotate this clause for grammatical metaphor with v2 JSON, MPP evidence, a congruent agnate, and exact sources.
